description: Impeccable design detector: immediate-tier checks after Edit/Write on UI files, full-rule deep pass on Stop.

hooks.command: engine="$HOME/.impeccable/vaultdex/engine-0.1.11/impeccable"; case "${OSTYPE:-}" in msys*|cygwin*) engine="$engine.exe";; esac; if [ -x "$engine" ]; then "$engine" hook; fi
engine="$HOME/.impeccable/vaultdex/engine-0.1.11/impeccable"; case "${OSTYPE:-}" in msys*|cygwin*) engine="$engine.exe";; esac; if [ -x "$engine" ]; then "$engine" hook; fi

launcher="$HOME/.ponytail/vaultdex/4.10.3-1/launch.sh"; if [ -f "$launcher" ]; then /bin/sh "$launcher" activate claude; else printf '%s\n' 'Ponytail hooks missing: run git submodule update --init --recursive, then node .vendor/workflow-kit/scripts/install-ponytail-hooks.mjs and trust the hooks.'; fi

engine="$HOME/.impeccable/vaultdex/engine-0.1.11/impeccable"; case "${OSTYPE:-}" in msys*|cygwin*) engine="$engine.exe";; esac; if [ ! -x "$engine" ]; then printf '%s\n' '{"systemMessage":"Impeccable hooks missing, UI checks are off: run git submodule update --init --recursive, then node .vendor/workflow-kit/scripts/install-impeccable-hooks.mjs and trust the hooks.","hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"SessionStart","additionalContext":"Impeccable hooks missing, UI checks are off: run git submodule update --init --recursive, then node .vendor/workflow-kit/scripts/install-impeccable-hooks.mjs and trust the hooks."}}'; fi

launcher="$HOME/.ponytail/vaultdex/4.10.3-1/launch.sh"; if [ -f "$launcher" ]; then /bin/sh "$launcher" activate claude continue; else printf '%s\n' 'Ponytail hooks missing: run git submodule update --init --recursive, then node .vendor/workflow-kit/scripts/install-ponytail-hooks.mjs and trust the hooks.'; fi
